svg.text: System Design NFR Cheat-Sheet: LASCSDIO + Latency, Availability, Consistency brackets
29 questions · highlighted cards are the three shown in the table
Latency: Standard = P99 under 200 ms, P999 under 500 ms · Tight = about 100 ms or less (typing, in-path, real-time) · Relaxed = seconds-level completion or a freshness target.
Availability: Avail-first = 99.99%, serve slightly stale rather than go down · Consist-first = 99.99%, reject or delay rather than be wrong · Standard = 99.9%.

Consistency: Strong = must never be wrong · Mixed = strong on the critical write path, eventual elsewhere · Eventual = stale or approximate data is acceptable. Suggested interview defaults; adjust to your interviewer.
